## Channel Selector (Cb)

Which distribution channels a listing publishes to. Seven check rows from the publish command's own `PUBLISH_CHANNELS` — MLS pinned checked and disabled with a Required tag ("Triggers automatic syndication to major portals"), Zillow/Realtor.com/Redfin tagged Auto-synced, the agent site and socials tagged Optional.

### Contract (render-only)

- `@selected: string[]` — the chosen channel values. The CONSUMER owns this set.
- `@onToggle(channel)` — the consumer adds/removes the channel from its set. MLS never fires it: the row is disabled because `PublishListingCommand` unions `'mls'` in regardless — the portals syndicate FROM the MLS entry, so a publish without it is not a thing this desk sells.
- `...attributes` ride onto the `<ul>` root.

Channel values and labels are imported from `../commands/publish-listing-command` (`PUBLISH_CHANNELS`, `PUBLISH_CHANNEL_LABELS`) — one definition, so the selector can never offer a channel the command doesn't know.

### Accessibility

Real `<input type='checkbox'>` per row inside its `<label>` — keyboard toggling, focus ring via `:focus-visible`, and the disabled MLS row reads as disabled to assistive tech.

### Colour (boxel-theming)

Token-only: checkbox `accent-color` rides `--primary`, tags on `--muted-foreground`, rows separated by `--border`. Zero hex literals.

### Non-goals

No persistence (channel preference storage is the consumer's), no publish action, no per-channel status — results render from the command's `channelResults`, not here.
